description: docs.documents.batchUpdate: POST v1/documents/{documentId}:batchUpdate. Applies one or more updates to the document. Each request is validated before being applied. If any request is not valid, then the entire request will fail and nothing will be applied. Some requests have replies to give you some information about how they are applied. Other requests do not need to return information; these each return an empty reply. The order of replies matches that of the requests. For example, suppose you call batchUpdate with four updates, and only the third one returns information. Body: vendor BatchUpdateDocumentRequest JSON, checked against the pinned discovery schema (each batchUpdate entry sets exactly one request kind). Runs as a background job; completion preserves the vendor response and names the selected account. key, access_token and oauth_token are refused: the connected account authenticates. Parameters use exact vendor names. See editors_api_coverage.md for scopes, bodies and lifecycle.
embedding_description: Use Docs Documents Batch Update to applies one or more updates to the document in Google Docs, as the selected connected Google account (POST v1/documents/{documentId}:batchUpdate). Send the vendor BatchUpdateDocumentRequest body; it is checked against Google's schema. Returns Google's full response.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued; completion includes account, method, full vendor response and response headers.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Show the account that answered and any reply objects in request order.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return one short message through the active IO plugin.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params names the argument or body field and the vendor rule it broke, including refused key/access_token/oauth_token; gsuite.unknown_account names connected accounts; gsuite.missing_scope requires reconnect; gsuite.auth_expired includes Testing-mode renewal guidance; gsuite.permission_denied, gsuite.not_found and gsuite.rate_limited preserve vendor messages.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Correct the named vendor field, choose a connected account, or reconnect with start_interface and connect_account to approve missing scopes. Retry rate limits later.
